original.not_on_bench: minmea is a plain C library; its original target is any C host. Expected values are what the two NMEA sentences in app/main.c parse to, with the timestamp from macOS timegm.

check.pass: The eight result globals read from the running board equal the values the two sentences parse to: both sentences parsed, 8 satellites, altitude 545.4 m (5454 dm), latitude 481172 and longitude 115166 (degrees x 10,000, latitude truncated by main.c), timestamp 764426119 (1994-03-23 12:35:19 UTC).

mspm0g3519.flash: OpenOCD (xPack) over the board's XDS110, program and verify. The app has no console output; the check halts the core and reads the globals.
